name: OpenAI Codex
tagline: OpenAI's coding agent for writing, reviewing and fixing code in the terminal, in your editor and in the cloud.
about: Codex is a software engineering agent from OpenAI. It can work on tasks in the background in a cloud sandbox and propose changes, or run locally through a command-line tool and editor extension.
pros: Runs tasks in the background and proposes pull requests.
Also works locally from the command line and in the editor.
cons: Usage limits depend on your ChatGPT plan.
